**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

The agreement contains no non-solicitation, no-hire, or anti-inducement covenant. Searches across the full document for "solicit," "hire," "employ," "induce," and "recruit" surfaced no restrictive covenant; the only "employ" hits are incidental references to employees in the definitions and indemnity sections. § 14.8 (Personnel), the natural location for such a restriction, deals only with each party's supervision of its own personnel, IBM's right to assign its personnel, and IBM's subcontracting rights.

This matches our preferred playbook position (no non-solicit binding Customer), so no edit is warranted. If IBM later proposes one in negotiation, we would hold to the fallback: mutual, limited to personnel directly involved in the Services, 12 months from the end of their involvement, with carve-outs for general advertisements and unsolicited approaches, and no no-hire.
